sections.text:
[Effects]
The following will activate if your Class is Soldier:
Increases physical Ability Power by XL.
The lower the current HP is when attacking, the greater the increase of physical Ability Power up to a max of 4XL.
Target: yourself. Increases Aggro for 10 seconds.

[Activation]
When a physical attack Ability is used.
Only activates when playing as Soldier.

[Activation Rate]
M
